description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RoviSys is seeking an entry-level Software Engineer to join its Thousand Oaks team. The role focuses on designing, developing, testing, implementing, integrating, and supporting software solutions for industrial and enterprise applications, databases, reporting, manufacturing, and business operations.
Entry-level software developer building, testing, integrating, and troubleshooting business applications and utilities

Responsibilities:
• Develop software applications and utilities based on functional requirements and technical specifications
• Participate in requirements gathering, design reviews, and software testing activities
• Write, debug, and maintain code using established development standards and best practices
• Assist in the development of software documentation, including design, test, and support documentation
• Support software integration with databases, enterprise applications, and operational systems
• Troubleshoot software issues and participate in root cause analysis activities
• Collaborate with project teams to deliver solutions on schedule and within budgeted hours
• Participate in internal training and professional development programs
• Develop and test software applications under the guidance of senior engineers
• Participate in project meetings and technical discussions
• Create and execute test plans for developed software
• Assist with database queries, reporting tools, and application integrations
• Support software deployments and customer acceptance testing
• Learn and apply RoviSys development standards, methodologies, and quality processes
• Travel occasionally to customer sites and other RoviSys offices as needed

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related engineering discipline
• 0-3 years of software development experience, including internships, co-op programs, academic projects, or professional experience
• Experience with one or more programming languages such as:
  + C#
  + PythonJava
  + JavaSc
  + ript/TypeScript
  + SQL
• Understanding of software development lifecycle concepts, debugging techniques, and testing methodologies
• Familiarity with relational databases and database design concepts
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative engineering team
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Demonstrates professional and ethical responsibilities in engineering and software development
